about.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.

name: v1.5.2
body:
## What's Changed

First stable release since **v1.5.0** (2026-08-16). It promotes **v1.5.2-beta.1** (`10442325`) unchanged and rolls up the v1.5.1 beta line (beta.1 → beta.4): **~150 merged changes over three months**, mostly session-stability, Claude Code / Codex reliability and platform fixes.

If you are on v1.5.0 or any `1.5.1-beta.*` / `1.5.2-beta.*`, **upgrading to v1.5.2 is recommended**. Configs from v1.5.0 work as-is.

### How this release was validated

- **Automated:** unit, regression and performance tests plus blackbox smoke in CI; release QA on the exact commit; a 14-case live Feishu channel smoke (Claude Code + Codex) on the release binary.
- **Upgrade path:** a v1.5.0 instance with existing sessions and cron jobs was upgraded in place. Sessions, `/list`, `/switch`, long-conversation context, cron jobs and Codex sessions all survived.
- **Manual acceptance on Feishu:**
  - AskUserQuestion cards: single choice, multi-select, and taps on stale cards;
  - permission cards (allow and deny);
  - `/list` card switching;
  - `/stop` mid-turn, messages sent while busy, `/compact`, `/restart`;
  - rich text with images, and Codex image input;
  - the Web dashboard.

### New Features

- **Web dashboard:** manage multi-workspace mode and channel bindings from the dashboard (#1772).
- **Feishu:**
  - optional receipt reaction when a message is accepted (#1812);
  - share group chat context on mention (#1698);
  - download the video file for media messages (#2013).
- **WeCom:** private (self-hosted) WeChat Work WebSocket deployment (#1703).
- **WPS Xiezuo:** chat attachments and cloud documents (#1850).
- **QQ:** `require_mention` gate for group messages (#1982).
- **MAX:** configurable inbound attachment download cap (#1837).
- **Claude Code:**
  - `context_window_tokens` option for the ctx% indicator (#1827);
  - tells the user when safeguards switch the session model (#2054).
- **Codex:**
  - GPT-5.6 reasoning and fallback support (#1815);
  - `max` reasoning effort (#1727);
  - GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 fallback models (#1939).
- **Cursor:** image attachments delivered to the CLI via on-disk paths (#1709).
- **Copilot:** tool execution and reasoning events forwarded to the engine (#1844).
- **ACP:**
  - context usage from opencode signals (#1790);
  - history via local Kimi transcripts (#1934).
- **Antigravity:** progress events streamed to cards (#1971).
- **i18n:** agent system prompt localized for cron, timer, send and relay (#1721).
- **Providers:** Atlas Cloud provider preset (#1540).

### Fixed

**Core and session stability**
- **Busy lock:** the session busy lock is generation-counted, recovers from a stuck lock, and is released on `/stop` (#1838). Fixes sessions stuck in "busy".
- **Idle auto-reset:**
  - locks the replacement session before releasing the old one (#1847);
  - counts queued messages toward `reset_on_idle_mins` (#2026);
  - no longer resets a session right after `/switch` (#1734).
- **Turn errors:**
  - background events keep flowing after a turn error (#2099);
  - a late session ID is still persisted (#1901).
- **Auto-compress:** driven by real reported token usage, not estimates (#1761, #1845); queued turns are logged after compression completes (#2071).
- **Card-driven `/switch`:** no longer clears history (#2009).
- **Stale AskUserQuestion taps:** dropped instead of being delivered to the agent (#2061).
- **Workspaces:**
  - stale workspace sessions are invalidated (#1699);
  - bindings are scoped to the platform thread (#2008);
  - the session store follows the engine store path (#1926).
- **Relay:** the timeout path no longer returns the target agent's tool output (#2028); full responses are kept in group echoes (#1979).
- **Message splitting:** keeps numbers, commands and references intact (#1975).
- **Progress cards:** recover after transient failures (#2090).

**Claude Code**
- Session teardown is bounded: WaitDelay, kill retry, close/spawn race guard and a fast graceful stop (#1714).
- `--replay-user-messages` is no longer passed, so `/compact` and similar commands stay reachable (#1737).
- AskUserQuestion is preserved in bypass modes (#1880).
- `/usage`: the probe no longer hangs (#2081) and its data race is fixed (#2134).
- `/history` fallback shows local time (#1788).
- ctx% uses the context window Claude Code reports (#2020).
- Session dirs are resolved from a per-project `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (#2059).
- A draft rejected by the Stop hook is dropped from the reply (#1855).
- An empty task-notification on `--resume` is dropped (#2069).

**Codex**
- **Turn completion:** waits for turn completion instead of thread idle (#2127) and for completed exec turns before follow-ups (#2063).
- **Ending turns:** turns terminate reliably on transport shutdown (#2115); failed app-server turns are propagated (#1730); concurrent exec turns are rejected (#1881).
- **Resume and history:** large resume responses (#1568) and large history records (#1917) are handled.
- **Session IDs and `/list`:** the session ID is persisted on thread start (#1623); `/list` shows correct session names (#1639) with segments deduplicated (#2060).
- **Async questions and subagents:** async questions surface and user answers route back (#2048); subagent events are isolated (#2086).
- **Images:** concurrent image attachment overwrites are prevented (#1983).
- **CLI discovery and transport:** current and legacy macOS desktop CLIs are found (#1928); `--listen` is not passed for the stdio transport (#1786).

**Feishu**
- Fails closed when bot open_id discovery fails at startup (#1725).
- `allow_from` is enforced on card actions (#1854).
- Unauthorized users are no longer answered for messages overheard via `group_reply_all` (#1539).
- AskUserQuestion is rendered as flat action rows (#1679).
- Large resources download via HTTP Range, working around code=234037 (#1746).
- Rich-text messages:
  - top-level files are included (#1888);
  - bot mentions are resolved before command dispatch (#2029);
  - `hr` elements are rendered as `---` in quoted posts (#1273).
- `merge_forward` content is expanded when quoting a reply (#1671).
- Video meeting cards and other unhandled types are passed to the agent (#2023).

**Other platforms**
- **DingTalk:**
  - quoted and reply messages are detected (#1912);
  - inline images in richText are forwarded (#1626);
  - group attachments use the group API (#1903);
  - expired session webhooks are handled (#1958);
  - a toggle controls the preview message after an AI Card completes (#1787).
- **Weixin:**
  - send budget is split by path, so replies are not charged to push (#1743, #2056);
  - inbound dedup is configurable (#1733);
  - message chunking is fence-aware (#1766);
  - voice transcription survives empty text items (#975).
- **Slack:**
  - working-indicator reactions go on the triggering message (#1523);
  - a message delivered as both app_mention and message is deduplicated (#1822);
  - tables and shared messages are forwarded (#2070).
- **Telegram:** sends and edits retry on 429 (#2082).
- **Discord:** event callbacks are guarded under the mutex (#1664).
- **QQ Bot:** quoted image attachments are forwarded (#1806).
- **MAX:** private-dialog callbacks are answered (#1848).
- **WPS Agentspace:** `allow_from` access control (#1962).

**Other agents**
- **ACP:**
  - resume uses `session/resume` (#2040);
  - thoughts are treated as thinking, not reply text (#1997);
  - tool names are kept across partial updates (#2073);
  - background text is relayed (#1936).
- **Pi:**
  - attachments are passed as path references (#1724, #1768);
  - `enabledModels` are treated as scope patterns (#2027);
  - `/ps` and `/btw` supplements are delivered (#1861);
  - Windows session dir paths are fixed (#1619, #1738).
- **Kimi:** CLI session history and model discovery are restored (#1916); sessions are filtered by cwd (#1840).
- **OpenCode:** the unsupported `--dir` flag is no longer passed (#2084); project env reaches multi-workspace agents (#1849).
- **Cursor:** the usage footer renders (#1811); Glob tool inputs are readable (#2110).
- **Copilot:** skills load (#1770, #1913).
- **Gemini:** options are kept for workspace agents (#2052).
- **Qoder:** the prompt is delivered via stdin (#1603).

**Daemon, config and install**
- **launchd:**
  - status handling is tightened (#1739);
  - a loaded job restarts without bootout (#1915);
  - the leftover child process is reaped on stop, restart and install (#1990).
- **Config:**
  - `~` is expanded in `work_dir` and `base_dir` (#1785);
  - the data dir falls back to home (#1514);
  - daemon install falls back to `~/.cc-connect/config.toml` (#1784).
- **Cron:**
  - `CRON_TZ` schedules are shown in their own timezone (#1922);
  - the timer span is capped to recover from system sleep (#1808);
  - an explicit `session_mode=reuse` is honored (#895).
- **Instance lock:** `--force` waits for the killed process to exit (#1017).
- **Windows:** absent taskkill targets are detected across locales (#2072).
- **Build:** the AGENTS and PLATFORMS include/exclude lists are normalized (#1033).

### Behavior changes worth knowing

- **Feishu fail-closed (#1725):** if the bot's open_id cannot be discovered at startup, the Feishu platform no longer starts half-working. Check app credentials and network if a Feishu bot stays silent after upgrading.
- **Claude Code `--replay-user-messages` removed (#1737):** fixes `/compact` and similar commands. No configuration change is needed.
- **Multi-select AskUserQuestion on Feishu:** answered by replying with option numbers (for example `1,3`). Single-choice questions keep buttons.

### Known issues

- **Dashboard multi-workspace:** enabling multi-workspace mode from the Web dashboard leaves `work_dir` in place, so the restart it asks for fails to load the config. Fixed on main in #2266 (ships in v1.5.3). Workaround: remove `work_dir` from that project's `[projects.agent.options]`.
- **Still open, reported against v1.5.0 or earlier:**
  - Telegram/Discord multi-select answered by the first tap (#2220);
  - Pi RPC slash commands hanging Telegram sessions (#2258);
  - QQ Bot passive-quota silent drops (#2216);
  - Windows orphaned `claude.exe` trees (#2209).
- **Less coverage this cycle:** live end-to-end acceptance covered Feishu with Claude Code and Codex. Other platforms and agents are covered by CI and the beta period. Please report regressions; rollback to v1.5.0 is supported.

### Breaking Changes

None. All new options are optional with safe defaults, and v1.5.0 configs upgrade as-is.

### Contributors

Thanks to the **69 external contributors** who landed 130 changes in this release, and to the cc-connect team. 🎉
